title: Organization schema names every North County town and carries a real address, geo and a logo above 192px

source.ref: Whole-site audit 2026-11-16 (project thread, requested by Daniel). Confidence: CONFIRMED. Audit file: audit/FINAL-BUILD-AND-REPAIR-LIST-2026-11-16.md

detail:
EVIDENCE: lib/site.ts:316 FOUNDING_CITIES = Oceanside, Carlsbad, Encinitas, Vista, San Marcos, Escondido; lib/maps/city-centroids.ts:13-17 already carries Solana Beach, Del Mar, Leucadia; emitted at lib/jsonld.ts:60-63. || lib/jsonld.ts:36-70: type Organization; foundingLocation address is region/country only (line 67); logo is /icons/icon-192.png (line 47); no telephone, no postal address.

WHY IT MATTERS: Answer engines resolve 'Frequency serves X' from areaServed; the coastal towns are the core market and are missing from the entity. Google local and AI engines have no consistent name/address/phone to cross-check against Google Business Profile, Yelp and directories. NAP consistency cannot be audited because there is no NAP.

FIX DIRECTION: Add Solana Beach, Del Mar, Cardiff, Leucadia (as neighbourhood/City) to FOUNDING_CITIES; keep llms.txt and the town pages in sync. Decide on a public city-level address (Oceanside/Encinitas etc.) or a service-area business, add addressLocality/addressRegion/postalCode to Organization, and use a 512px square logo.

2026-11-16: FOUNDING_CITIES now includes Cardiff, Leucadia, Solana Beach and Del Mar; Organization logo is the 512px icon; foundingLocation carries addressLocality. OPEN OWNER DECISION: a real public city, postal code and phone for NAP consistency (none invented).
